statement.title: Accessibility Statement
statement.intro: The Valentina Ben Ami Furniture website is committed to providing equal, accessible service to all customers, in accordance with the Israeli Equal Rights for Persons with Disabilities regulations (2013) and Israeli Standard 5568 at level AA.

features.f1: Floating accessibility menu: text enlargement, high contrast, grayscale, link highlighting, readable font and stopping animations
features.f2: Full keyboard navigation with a clear focus indicator
features.f3: Image descriptions (alt) and ARIA labels on interactive elements
features.f4: Proper heading structure and standard-compliant color contrast

statement.contactText: Found an accessibility issue? We'd love to fix it. Contact our accessibility coordinator by phone:

terms.title: Terms of Service & Policy
terms.intro: These terms are an initial draft and will be filled in with the store's official content soon. Until then they serve as a general framework only.

sections.title: Orders & Payment
sections.body: Prices shown on the site are a price quote and not a final charge. After an order is submitted, a store representative will contact you to confirm details, availability, and timing before any payment is taken.

sections.title: Cancellation & Returns
sections.body: Orders may be cancelled in accordance with Israel's Consumer Protection Law, 1981. Delivered products may be returned in their original condition within 14 days, subject to prior coordination with the store.

sections.title: Warranty
sections.body: Store products carry a manufacturer's warranty as detailed on the warranty card included with the product (where applicable). Contact us by phone for details.

sections.title: Privacy
sections.body: Customer details collected when placing an order are used only to coordinate the order and are not shared with third parties except as needed to fulfill delivery.

delivery.title: Delivery & Order Terms
delivery.intro: The store's delivery and order terms. These must be accepted when placing an order.

sections.title: Price & Payment
sections.body: The order price is fixed and will not change, except for tax changes required by law. Full payment must be settled in-store before the delivery date — delivery will not take place without full settlement.

sections.title: Delivery Time
sections.body: Domestically-made products: 21-30 estimated business days. Imported products: 60-90 estimated business days. Dates are estimates only and may change.

sections.title: Manufacturer Warranty
sections.body: Manufacturers are responsible for their products for one year from the delivery date, subject to Israel's Sale Law.

sections.title: Order Cancellation
sections.body: Since the order is made specifically for the customer, cancelling it carries a fee of at least 25% of the order's value.

sections.title: Ownership Until Full Payment
sections.body: The product remains the store's property until all payments are fully settled.

sections.title: Delivery, Assembly & Access
sections.body: Delivery and assembly are not included in the price and are not the store's responsibility unless agreed in advance for an additional fee. Please specify the floor and access conditions (elevator/stairs) when ordering — depending on location, floor, and access conditions, additional charges may apply.
